channel.title: Boulder City Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Boulder City Review (bouldercityreview.com)

item.title: Eagles look for another state title on court
item.description: With their eyes on recapturing the 3A state title, Boulder City High School boys volleyball challenged themselves early with some stiff competition in the Las Vegas Invitational.

item.title: Eagles dominate competition in pool
item.description: On the hunt for their fourth consecutive 3A state championship, Boulder City High School boys swimming didn’t disappoint in their season opener at Heritage on Feb. 28, defeating Coral Academy 640-333.

item.title: ‘Coach Bubba’ Mariani denies lewd acts with Boulder City players
item.description: Attorney enters a not guilty plea for ex–Boulder City High School football coach Frank “Bubba” Mariani, accused of lewd acts on children and child abuse charges.

item.title: CCSD looks at consolidations
item.description: The Clark County School District continues to struggle financially as the growth of the nation’s fifth-largest school district has slowed at the same time students and parents are finding alternative education options.

item.title: Residents to vote on two local ballot questions
item.description: The Boulder City Council did its part and now the city is asking residents to do the same.

item.title: Newsom stops in BC
item.description: Last Wednesday, California Gov. Gavin Newsom made a stop in Boulder City at the home of Judy Hoskins during an invitation-only gathering to help promote his new book, “Young Man in a Hurry.” He appeared at an event later that night in Las Vegas.

item.title: Volleyball team evens record at 4-4
item.description: Advancing to 4-4 on the season, Boulder City High School boys volleyball earned impressive victories over higher classified Green Valley and Silverado.

item.title: Bryan coming to town to discuss new book
item.description: In the world of Nevada politics, Richard Bryan did it all.

item.title: Track teams shine at home meet
item.description: Hosting a weekday event on March 4, both the girls and boys Boulder City High School track and field programs showed off their strengths.

item.title: Eagles start season in style on the diamond
item.description: Boulder City High School baseball picked up their first victory of the season on March 5, upsetting 5A Foothill, 6-5.
